why: Each day the graph is 'merchants sharing an active link type', and clusters are its connected components. Union every merchant holding the same active link (union-find, or BFS over a link to merchants map), then apply the pin rules by intersecting each component with the previous day's pin set. Degree uses distinct neighbours.
hints: Group active (merchant, link) pairs by link type first. Merchants sharing a link form a clique, but for connectivity you only need to union them in a chain.

For each day, compute components (size >= 2) and degrees (distinct neighbours, via a set per merchant). Then for each component look at which previous pins it contains: 0 means fresh by max degree, 1 means keep it, 2 or more means pick among them by max degree.
With 200 merchants, rebuild everything per day: DSU for components, sets for degrees. Sort clusters by (-size, pin) and members lexicographically. Trivial cost.
pitfalls: Duration includes the report day: duration 2 on day 1 covers days 1-2. A renewal extends activity, it does not reset it.
Merchants persist after their links expire, but singletons are never printed.
Degree counts distinct neighbours even if they share several links.
Always print the 'Day X:' header, even with no clusters.
